content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["The film drops off Navy Seals in a jungle to find a lost submarine, only to reveal a huge submarine with helicopters circling it after a short walk.","The film shows marines dropping into a Nevada bunker, only to find half the mountain blown out and a huge monster heading toward the city they just came from.","The film depicts a tugboat carrying a nuke passing the Golden Gate Bridge, with a helicopter rescuing the hero and clearing the blast radius without turbulence."]}
